test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question:
In this question, a statement is given followed by three conclusions. Choose the conclusion(s) which best fit(s) logically.

**Statement:**

U = V U

II. Z > U

III. Z < U

options.text: Only conclusions II and III are true
Only conclusions I and II are true
Only conclusions I and III are true

solution: Given Statement: U = V Conclusions: I: W > U → True (U = V It gives W > U)
